sections.heading: What is trending: “school”
paragraphs: “school” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for ZA (snapshot taken 2026-09-15T04:54:13+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 2,000 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from HELLO! Magazine, The Guardian, The Telegraph. The headlines, exactly as published:
list: “Prince Harry and Meghan Markle switch Archie and Lilibet's school just days after term begins” — HELLO! Magazine
“Duke and Duchess of Sussex granted security review after return to UK” — The Guardian

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Mon, 14 Sep 2026 15:00:00 -0700. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-09-15T04:54:13+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-09-15T04:54:57+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.
